sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: The trace of where information came from and how it reached this record.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: A quotation needs a book, edition and page—not just the author’s name.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: Teaching scenario: an authorized Drive document contains “Joule Studio is an environment for developing AI agents at SAP.” The sentence is illustrative source text, not a fact verified by this site.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: The Source → Document → DocumentVersion → Chunk → Assertion lineage is preserved.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Without lineage, a changed or deleted original makes old answers difficult to explain.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Historical authorization snapshots are evidence of past context, not permanent access grants. Reads check current authorization.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.

steps.title: Original source
steps.body: Drive retains the original. This example is illustrative, not a live provider run.

steps.title: Observe and translate
steps.body: The connector reads an authorized folder snapshot and prepares a manifest.

steps.title: Bind the source
steps.body: The source has a stable identity and connector binding.

steps.title: Identify the document
steps.body: The external file identity becomes a stable Document identity.

steps.title: Preserve this version
steps.body: Content, metadata and authorization belong to a preserved snapshot.

steps.title: Parse and chunk
steps.body: Supported text is parsed and deterministically split; F6 remains open.

steps.title: Keep exact evidence
steps.body: Each chunk points to its immutable version.

steps.title: Suggest knowledge
steps.body: A separate producer may use versioned prompts. Automated extraction is deferred.

steps.title: Submit a proposal
steps.body: The candidate and its evidence enter review, not canonical truth.

steps.title: Validate and approve
steps.body: An authorized review checks evidence and ontology; open F4/F5 limits remain.

steps.title: Store governed knowledge
steps.body: Entities and assertions retain evidence lineage in Neo4j.

steps.title: Find supporting context
steps.body: Keyword/semantic retrieval and separate graph reads serve authorized consumers.

steps.title: Use the evidence
steps.body: API/MCP deliver context. A consuming human or agent interprets it; answer generation is external.
